The readable-stream end-of-stream implementation says:

  This module is a simplified port from the eos module written by
  Mathias Buus for Node.js.

The readable-stream pipeline implementation says:

  Ported from https://github.com/mafintosh/pump with permission from the
  author, Mathias Buus (@mafintosh).

The fs-node-builtins internal errors implementation says that it was adapted
from Node's internal/errors implementation.

The get-intrinsic implementation says that part of its logic was adapted from
lodash 4.17.15.
